items.text: Finding accuracy: the decisive evidence is found and correctly interpreted; no invented defect.
Escalation: the outcome matches who owns the decision (Prime within direction, or the Director).
Preservation: reasons are given and exact quotes or source references are kept where wording matters.
Economy: no unnecessary work, redundant re-runs or scope beyond the review.
Next action: one bounded, non-dispatched proposed action that follows from the finding.
